ev.q: Among 1,440 COVID-19 case-patients who received IMV or died, 307 (21%) had received 2 or 3 vaccine doses before illness onset.
Receiving 2 or 3 doses of an mRNA COVID-19 vaccine was associated with a 90% reduction in risk for COVID-19–associated IMV or death.
Among 6,104 control-patients, 4,020 (66%) had received 2 or 3 vaccine doses.
VE was calculated using unconditional logistic regression
Results were stratified by age, immunocompromising conditions, number of categories of chronic medical conditions
Using a case-control design, mRNA vaccine effectiveness (VE) against COVID-19–associated IMV and in-hospital death was evaluated
restricting COVID-19 test-negative control-patients to those who also received IMV or died

methods_quotes.q: VE was calculated using unconditional logistic regression
estimates were adjusted for U.S. Health and Human Services region, calendar time in biweekly intervals, age, sex
Results were stratified by age, immunocompromising conditions, number of categories of chronic medical conditions
were compared using Pearson’s chi-square for categorical variables or Wilcoxon rank-sum tests for continuous variables
Age-specific models were adjusted for age as a continuous variable.
